Overview

Tyumen is a city in Tyumen Oblast with a population of 820,000. The first Russian city in Siberia, now a wealthy oil and gas hub with a high standard of living and modern urban development. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4a growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
